rejected_rule.statement: Where there are several co-lessors, each can sue only for his share of the damages caused by breach of covenants in a lease unless otherwise agreed upon.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: "That this is the position of several lessors where there is no stipulation to the contrary has been recognized in local cases. ... For example, though one of two lessees can fulfil his obligation of payment of rent by paying his share of it to the lessor, can be resist an action for cancellation of the lease brought against himself and his co-lessor for default in payment of rent by the latter?"
